和一家势力约定好价格，到期时交货或收货。交货合约是到期把货交给对方，收货合约是到: Agree a price with a faction now and deliver or take the goods at expiry. A delivery contract hands the goods over at expiry; a receipt contract pays for them and takes them in. The longer the term, the higher the premium in the agreed price.
签约时先付保证金（名义金额 ÷ 杠杆）和 0.5% 开仓费。价格朝不利方向走，维: Signing pays the margin (notional ÷ leverage) and a 0.5% opening fee. When the price moves against you the maintenance ratio falls: below 100% you must top up the margin before 08:00 the next day; below 50% the position is closed at once.
到期时自动交割：交货合约从仓库扣货，收货合约扣款、货物入库。货或钱不够就算违约：: Contracts settle by themselves at expiry: a delivery contract takes the goods from the warehouse, a receipt contract pays and stores the goods. Short of goods or money, it defaults: the margin is forfeit, relations −40, and no new contracts with that faction during the cooldown.
不交收实物，只按开仓价和平仓价的差额结算盈亏。看涨就做多，看跌就做空。杠杆把保证: No goods change hands: profit and loss are the difference between the opening and closing price. Go long if you expect a rise, short if you expect a fall. Leverage turns the margin into a larger notional, and the profit or loss grows with it.
每家发行方按关系等级给持仓上限，每升一级多 5 万。持仓每天收名义金额 0.02: Each issuer caps your positions by relation rank, 50,000 more per rank. Open positions pay a daily overnight fee of 0.02% of the notional. Maintenance works as for forwards: top up below 100%, closed below 50%. Take-profit and stop-loss can be set on the Positions page.
九大势力各有一条关系，到 150 / 500 / 1000 / 2500 / 5: Each of the nine factions has a relation that ranks up at 150 / 500 / 1000 / 2500 / 5000. Each new rank sends a gift; higher ranks open special goods and better terms. Trades, orders, gifts and medical stays all raise relations.
每家势力对罗德岛都有一个期望关系，超过的部分每天会被慢慢修正回来，超得越多修正越: Each faction has an expected relation with Rhodes Island; anything above it is corrected back a little each day, faster the further above. "Correction −n/day" is what that day takes. Below the expected value it does not fall; a defaulted contract takes relations directly.
企鹅物流关系够高后，可以买企鹅专递单：交给罗德岛小队或营地，多少东西都直接送回仓: With a high enough relation, Penguin Logistics sells Express Slips: hand one to the Rhodes squad or a camp and everything goes straight back to the warehouse. Rush Slips kept in the warehouse halve the return time of insured gear, one per piece.
按当前报价立即成交。上半部分卖出这一大类里背包和仓库中的物品，下半部分买入这家势: Trades fill at once at the current quote. The top half sells items of this category from the pack and the warehouse; the bottom half buys the packs and special goods this faction sells. Each faction quotes in its own currency, and selling also raises relations.
不想按现价成交，就挂单等价格到位。限价卖：价格涨到设定价时卖出；止损卖：价格跌到: To trade at a price other than now, place an order and wait. Limit sell: sells when the price rises to yours. Stop sell: sells at market once the price falls to yours. Limit buy: buys when the price falls to yours. Conditional sell: sells when another market on your watchlist meets the condition.
挂单时物品先交给交易所托管，并付交付价 0.5% 的手续费。期限可选当日到 7: Placing an order hands the item to the exchange to hold and costs 0.5% of its delivery value. Terms run from today to 7 days; "Settlement" keeps it until the next contract settles. Each faction takes 3 orders plus its relation rank.
各地区货币盘与交叉盘。罗德岛只持有龙门币和赤金，其他货币只用来报价，用外币成交时: Currency pairs and crosses of every region. Rhodes Island holds only LMD and Pure Gold; other currencies are only for quotes, and a trade priced in one is settled in LMD at the rate of the time. This page swaps LMD and Pure Gold, and FX CFDs bet on rates rising or falling.
龙门币和赤金按实时汇率整块互换，买入和卖出各有 0.5% 价差。在基地换到的赤金: LMD and Pure Gold swap in whole bars at the live rate, with a 0.5% spread on each side. Pure Gold bought at the base goes straight to the warehouse.
窗口模式、垂直同步、用哪块显卡、震屏强度，以及 Boss 登场演出是否播放。: Window mode, V-Sync, which graphics card to use, screen shake strength, and whether boss entrances play.
界面动效、交易确认、伤害数字、订单追踪、PRTS 提示、新手与主线引导和语言。自: Interface motion, trade confirmation, damage numbers, order tracking, PRTS notices, the tutorial and story guides, and language. Auto potion: below the lower bound the operator drinks the potion in the hotbar's auto slot, and stops at the upper bound. Auto treatment: after a failed run, the fallen operator's injury is healed at once if the LMD cover it.
基地左上角的站点总览可以整个隐藏，也可以逐个选择列出哪些站点。下方可以在桌面创建: The station overview at the base's top left can be hidden entirely, or you can pick which stations it lists. Below, create desktop shortcuts for the trading terminal and the ticker window: watch the market without the game running, and place orders from the terminal.
按大类筛选仓库，只列出这一类并自动排好。自由摆放、旋转和整理只在“全部”页。: Filter the warehouse by category: only that kind is listed, sorted automatically. Free placement, rotating and sorting are only on the All page.
收藏品是外勤里找到的纪念物，不能装备。可露希尔升级整理箱要用收藏品；在加工站把它: Collectibles are keepsakes found in the field and cannot be equipped. Closure needs them to upgrade cases; packed into gift packs at the workshop, they raise relations with a faction, more so with the faction from the collectible's home region.
背包里能卖的物品标着收购价，拖到货架上卖出；标不出价的这里不收。货架上列出在这里: Items in your pack that sell here show their offer; drag one onto the shelf to sell it. Items with no price are not bought here. The shelf lists what you sold here, and you can buy it back at the sale price before you leave.
